evidence.text: I taught myself programming and built an API for a neighborhood lending app.
I implemented its database access using SQL queries.
I wrote automated software tests for reservations.
Neighbors use the application I built to borrow equipment.
I developed a REST API to expose laboratory measurements.
I wrote SQL queries to filter experiment records.
I wrote automated unit and integration tests.
I conducted computational biology research using code I wrote.
I recruited developers who built REST APIs, wrote SQL queries, created automated software tests and maintained services in production. I never performed those engineering tasks.
I built a REST API and wrote SQL queries.
I check the application by clicking through it manually. I have never written automated software tests.
